content: Internal Revenue Service, this is Officer Daniel Harper, badge number 461782. Who am I speaking with?
Uh, hi, this is Alex. I got a message about my taxes and something about a case number?

Yes, Alex. I have your file in front of me regarding a federal investigation into tax discrepancies for the last two years. Can you verify your date of birth and mailing address so I can confirm your file?
Yeah, sure. My birthday is March 15, 1999, and my address is 2401 Maple Drive, Apt 4, Riverside.
Thank you. For security, can you also provide the last four digits of your Social Security number?
Um, it's 4472.
Alright, that's confirmed. Alex, you are currently listed as a primary suspect in a tax fraud case. The IRS has found serious inconsistencies in your federal tax filings.
Wait, what? I just filed my taxes for the first time this year. I don't understand.
According to our records, there are underreported incomes totaling $5,300. Due to this, a warrant for your immediate arrest has been issued, and your bank accounts are scheduled for seizure.
What? Arrest? No, there must be some mistake. I didn't do anything wrong.
This is a federal matter. If you do not resolve this now, you could face up to five years in prison and a fine of $25,000. Do you want to resolve this outside of court?
Yes, please, I don't want any trouble. What am I supposed to do?
The only way to temporarily suspend the arrest warrant is to settle your outstanding balance immediately. Are you able to make a payment today?
I think so. I have a debit card and some savings, but I'm not sure how much.

Alright. We do not accept regular card payments for pending legal cases. You will need to purchase government-approved prepaid vouchers to resolve this. Do you have a store like Walmart or Walgreens nearby?
I think there's a Walgreens a few blocks from here.
Good. Take your debit card and go to that Walgreens now. You must purchase $2,000 in Apple Gift Cards. Do not discuss this with anyone at the store; it is a confidential federal investigation.
Apple Gift Cards? For taxes? That just sounds kind of strange...
The IRS is using digital payment methods to expedite fraud cases. If you delay or refuse, the local police will be notified within the hour. Do you understand?
Okay, I guess so. What exactly do I need to buy?
Purchase four Apple Gift Cards of $500 each. Once you have them, call me back at this number and read the codes to me directly so I can process the payment and stop the legal action.
Alright. How long do I have? I need to get ready.
You have 30 minutes before your file is transferred to the local authorities. I suggest you leave immediately. Do not hang up the phone until you have the cards; I will stay on the line.
I'm leaving now. I just really don't want to get arrested.
That is why I am assisting you, Alex. Remember, do not discuss the details of this investigation with anyone at the store. Are you at the Walgreens now?
Yes, I'm here. I see the gift cards on the rack.
Excellent. Pick up four $500 Apple Gift Cards and proceed to the cashier. After paying, scratch the back of each card and read me the codes, one by one.
Okay, I have the cards. The first code is X3DP-29LK-7WQJ-8M9V.
Thank you. Please provide the remaining three codes so I can process the total payment amount.
